Hi Rishi,

We just completed a self-serve signup (account: Kudos AI) and our engineering lead is locked in a product demo with a customer next week. The account is currently blocked by quota while we exercise the playground. The signup form asked us to email to request promotional/trial credits — I was told to reach out to a sales contact.

- Account email: emma@kudos.ai

Thanks — Emma

Thanks for the note, Emma — welcome and congrats on the demo.

Short answer: yes, we can do a quickstart credit to unblock the account. To keep things fast I typically approve up to $500 in free credits (approx 40k tokens depending on model) for new PLG signups without formal paperwork. If you expect to exceed that or need multi-week support, we'll need a one-page company verification (we can accept a simple company letterhead PDF or a registrar screenshot).

Before I issue: could you confirm the account email (is emma@kudos.ai the billing/login email?) and which model you plan to test (we have lower-cost embedding vs. gen models)? Also, any regulatory constraints (PHI) in the demo?

If everything looks standard I'll ask Marissa (sales ops) to create the credit and attach it to the account. You should see the credit code applied within 1 business hour after we create it.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
